title: Localized listings config
description: The LOCALIZED_LISTINGS object (remote) or config.localizedListings (local). Without baseUrl and urlTemplate the integration is off. Flutter has no support (known drift).

_synthetic.description: Fixture marker. Present only in hand-made fixtures, never on the wire.

enabled.description: Master switch. A present object counts as on; false turns it off.

source.description: Label for the source, for example 'sportserver'.

urlTemplate.description: File name template with a {state} token, for example 'sports-img-data-sm-webp-{state}.json'.

frequency.description: Dispersion percent: 25 puts a localized listing in every 4th slot. A number or a numeric string.

forceState.description: Force a 2-letter state instead of geo resolution.
